description: TowerFall Ascension + Dark World (Matt Makes Games, GOG v2.5.0.6, via Proton)
long: TowerFall Ascension is an archery combat platformer focused on local couch multiplayer, where up to four players battle in single-screen arenas using arrows and head-stomps. The Dark World expansion adds new versus content plus a cooperative survival quest mode against waves of enemies. It was created by Matt Thorson's Matt Makes Games.
